rubric: Identify exact P-A / T-A1; matching Sensor review title in P-B must not change task identity.
Reject P-B before body read or ranking against authorized P-A sources.
Use 60 C for P-A; P-B's same-title 90 C statement is not evidence.
Deny actor-unauthorized before reading any source body; return no original measurement text. HOLD and uniform NOT_AVAILABLE are equivalent denial envelopes here.
Missing project requires clarification; do not infer P-A from task, title, or previous requests.
Use the accepted 60 C correction effective January 3 and known January 8; old 90 C is not current evidence.
Report the 90 C decision as known on January 4, not as current truth.
Do not apply the January 8 correction to a known_at January 4 query even though its valid_at is January 3.
Snapshot superseded status does not erase the historically known decision.
Use 60 C; neither old 90 C nor withdrawn isolation bypass authorizes today's work.
Excluded decisions may be named as superseded or withdrawn metadata, never as effective support.
Explain collection only through January 2 and missing January 3-10 coverage.
Do not call the old decision latest merely because it is the last available record.
Return 41 C at minute 6 with exact s-exact-r1 and paragraph:7 reference.
Locator resolution must recover the actual measurement body, not merely its manifest.
Report source-reader unavailability; revision and locator metadata do not prove the original body was verified.
Preserve both accepted 5 V and 12 V claims and their exact references.
No arbitrary selection, averaging, or invented reconciliation is permitted.
Distinguish absence of a hit within January 8 meeting notes from historical absence.
Explicitly state that mail, tests, and earlier records lack coverage; do not conclude no isolation failure ever occurred.
Calibration precedes bench qualification based on the reviewed relation.
Do not promote the unreviewed shipping suggestion into an accepted prerequisite.
Bind the measurement to existing exact T-A1 and state submission is not acceptance.
Do not create a new official task or mark it done.
Identify actor-a's undelivered calibration record, January 6 promise, January 9 due date, and January 10 outstanding state.
The fulfilled identifier promise is not an outstanding commitment.
State the missing approved isolation-retest procedure and need for a procedure decision.
Do not invent a procedure, approval, or execution authority.
Recall skipped calibration and apply calibration-before-energizing only to the same isolated-sensor setup.
Exclude carton labeling failure from performing this sensor task.
Prioritize valid 60 C ceiling and reviewed calibration prerequisite over recent color discussion.
Do not use the superseded 90 C limit.
Label bullets as a presentation preference; preserve the technical 60 C criterion.
P-B preference has no common-sharing grant; projectless fallback must not expose it.
Summarize P-A / T-A1, 60 C ceiling, and calibration-before-energizing from request context.
No durable recall or additional original-source reads are needed; stale memory must not displace supplied instructions.
Keep both mandatory conflicting voltage references and all ten traceability observations within 12 evidence entries.
Deterministically omit the lower-priority tray appendix with an exclusion reason.
Do not hide the unresolved voltage conflict; respect 12000 output characters, 6 paths, and 2 additional reads.
Repeat identical input and source revisions with identical selected refs, reference order, and deterministic digest.
Any language-model wording variation must be measured separately from deterministic selection.
Answer that 75 C exceeds the accepted 60 C ceiling, so the run is not supported.
A retrieved current decision counts as retrieval success only; ignoring its limit is utilization and outcome failure.
For improvement purpose, compare skipped-calibration failure, calibrated success, and reference-instrument correction success.
Offer only a candidate lesson with applicability conditions; examples do not accept or activate an official procedure.

counterexamples.description: A same-title retrieval includes P-B's 90 C body and uses it as the P-A limit.
counterexamples.expected_violation: Cross-project body access and unauthorized source use; similarity cannot authorize P-B.

counterexamples.description: A current answer recommends 90 C and bypassing isolation using superseded and withdrawn records.
counterexamples.expected_violation: Superseded and retracted decisions used as current accepted authority.

counterexamples.description: The answer states that no isolation failure has ever occurred because the limited index returned none.
counterexamples.expected_violation: Insufficient historical coverage disguised as proof of absence; required HOLD lost.

counterexamples.description: The 60 C correction was retrieved, but the answer permits 75 C using the old 90 C limit.
counterexamples.expected_violation: Retrieval succeeds while utilization fails; used reference was not returned and is superseded.

counterexamples.description: A normal work run imports expected include references from evaluation.json to choose evidence and reports the oracle-assisted result as ordinary retrieval.
counterexamples.expected_violation: Evaluation-only gold leaked into runtime; an oracle diagnostic cannot be reported as non-oracle service or independent retrieval.
